items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Bootie Woods was with me on Dutch Kitchen BOUNCE, and we wrote that together.

ctx.x: : No. Well now, okay, so you've got this band, and you work seven months. Now, what is happening that you got into the hospital?

Well, let's get back to the record first, STANLEY (Inaudible). I had -- I didn't have a title to "Dutch Kitchen BOUNCE." I didn't have a title to Go, Red, Go. They were just numbers that we played, and they're my original numbers, because Bootie Woods was with me on Dutch Kitchen BOUNCE, and we wrote that together.

Bob Causer, who was the owner of the Ithaca Hotel in Ithaca, New York, and had a swank eating joint on Cornell University campus called Dutch Kitchen Inn, he came up to my recording session on the first day, and he was a guy who liked, would -- with "St. Vitus Dance," you know.
